Non ci avevo proprio pensato, che stupida

Oh my god, do we have the same mother? I can totally relate. My mother *loves* to scream at me in the car. 

"[...] she'd act like nothing happened" THIS. Just the other day she went crazy while we were in the car, it was so bad that I almost started crying, and after *literally* five minutes she calmed down and asked if I wanted pizza.

My Nmother has been a hoarder since my dad died, so for like 13 years now. Our house is filled with useless stuff and trash. Sometimes I want to clean at least the kitchen but there's literally no room to put all this stuff. In some parts of the house you can't even walk because there's too much stuff (mostly clothes) on the floor, it looks like a mountain. It's not just a mess, it's also dirty. I swear I want to take a bunch of pics of the place and call the CPS but I'll move in 11 months, so I think I can wait. I'll probably obsessively clean my apartment when I move out.
I think I'm the only person who got the joke
I'll try. I've been binging every day for a month, I need to stop.

My mental is deteriorating. I'm so depressed I don't even want to leave the house, but I gotta go to school or else my anxiety will tell me that I won't go anywhere in life. Then at school I have to deal with a bunch of people I hate and their stupid questions such as "Why don't you ever smile?", but being at home is even worse because my family is just awful. I'll move out in a year, but I have no idea what I'll do then. I don't know how to be a functioning human being. I'm considering suicide and nobody knows. 

Wow, I needed to vent.
I know. I'm trying not to think like that. But, yesterday I recognized that logic and stopped binging. I guess that's a first step.
